cards.title: 5.1.1 The Need for Homeostasis
body: Controlling the concentration of substances in the body is also important to maintain good health condition.
As deficiency of iron can lead to anemia; excess absorption of iron can be toxic, especially to children.

cards.title: Homeostasis and negative feedback
body: **Homeostasis** is keeping the internal environment (temperature, water, glucose, pH) nearly constant. It works by **negative feedback**: a change from the normal level is detected

cards.title: Homeostasis
body: Keep internal conditions steady (temp, glucose, water). Negative feedback reverses change.
Skin, liver, kidneys, hormones all help.

cards.title: Osmoregulation sketch
body: ADH ↑ → kidneys reabsorb more water → urine concentrated.
Thirst + behaviour also restore balance.

cards.title: 5.2.1 Structure of the Mammalian Kidney
body: The kidneys are a pair of vital organs that perform a variety of functions.
Every day, a person’s kidneys process approximately 189 litres of blood and filters out about two litres of waste products and excess water.

cards.title: 5.2.2 Osmoregulation by the Kidney
body: Osmoregulation is the process which regulates the concentration and osmotic pressure of blood by regulating the water contents of blood plasma.
At the same time excess water intake may dilute the body fluids.

lessons.title: The Control of the Blood Glucose

cards.title: 5.3.1 The Pancreas and its Hormones
body: The pancreas secretes the hormones insulin and glucagon to control the level of glucose in the blood.
The body of a healthy person, who has not eaten for some time, releases a small amount of insulin into the bloodstream throughout the day and night.

cards.title: 5.3.2 The Liver and Sugar Control
